or &#8220;Spin-Off&#8221;). style="text-indent:22.5pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:112%">First Quarter 2026 Results</font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">Revenue for the First Quarter 2026 was $2,212 million, an increase of 9% compared to the prior&#8209;year period. Adjusted for the impact of foreign currency exchange and commodity pass&#8209;through, revenue increased approximately 3% during the First Quarter 2026. Growth was driven by higher volumes in North America and Asia Pacific reflecting stronger customer demand despite lower global automotive production.</font></div><div style="text-indent:22.5pt"><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">Net income attributable to Versigent was $78 million, compared to $95 million in the prior&#8209;year period.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">Adjusted EBITDA for the First Quarter 2026 totaled $203 million, compared to $198 million in the prior&#8209;year period. Adjusted EBITDA margin was 9.2%, compared to 9.8% in the prior&#8209;year period. Adjusted EBITDA margin reflected disciplined operating execution and higher volumes, despite headwinds related to commodity costs and foreign exchange impacts. </font></div><div style="height:42.75pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="padding-left:18pt;padding-right:18pt;text-align:center;text-indent:-18pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="padding-left:18pt;padding-right:18pt;text-align:center;text-indent:-18pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="padding-left:18pt;padding-right:18pt;text-align:center;text-indent:-18pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="padding-left:18pt;padding-right:18pt;text-align:center;text-indent:-18pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="padding-left:18pt;padding-right:18pt;text-align:center;text-indent:-18pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="padding-left:18pt;padding-right:18pt;text-align:center;text-indent:-18pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="padding-left:18pt;padding-right:18pt;text-align:center;text-indent:-18pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="padding-left:18pt;padding-right:18pt;text-align:center;text-indent:-18pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="padding-left:18pt;padding-right:18pt;text-align:center;text-indent:-18pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="padding-left:18pt;padding-right:18pt;text-align:center;text-indent:-18pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="padding-left:18pt;padding-right:18pt;text-align:center;text-indent:-18pt"><font><br></font></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="min-height:42.75pt;width:100%"><div><font><br></font></div></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">Interest expense for the First Quarter 2026 totaled $5 million, compared to $2 million in the prior&#8209;year period. The increase was related to the issuance of the Company&#8217;s Senior Notes and Credit Agreement in connection with the Spin-Off.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">Income tax benefit for the First Quarter 2026 was $9 million, compared to income tax expense of $29 million in the prior&#8209;year period. The change primarily reflected discrete tax benefits recognized during the First Quarter 2026.</font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%"> </font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">Net cash provided by operating activities for the First Quarter 2026 was $36 million, compared to $40 million in the prior-year period, reflecting earnings performance partially offset by working capital investment during the period. Capital expenditures totaled $66 million for the First Quarter 2026. Free cash flow was $(30) million for the First Quarter 2026, compared to $3 million in the prior-year period. The decrease in free cash flow compared to the prior-year period was primarily driven by an increase in restructuring costs, one-time separation costs and capital expenditures during the First Quarter 2026.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:112%">Capital Allocation</font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">Versigent remains committed to a disciplined and balanced capital allocation framework, prioritizing continued growth, maintaining a strong balance sheet, and returning cash to shareholders. In April 2026, Versigent&#8217;s board of directors approved a dividend policy, under which the Company intends to return a portion of future earnings to shareholders in the range of $0.13 per share quarterly, with the initial dividend expected to be declared at a future date. Any dividends will only be payable when, as, and if declared by the board of directors. In addition, Versigent&#8217;s board of directors approved a share repurchase program for up to $250 million of the Company&#8217;s shares. This repurchase program does not have an expiration date and may be amended, suspended, or terminated by the board of directors at any time. Under the repurchase program, the Company intends to purchase shares from time to time on the open market. The number of shares ultimately purchased, and the timing of purchases are at the discretion of management and subject to compliance with applicable laws and regulations.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:112%">2026 Building on a legacy of engineering excellence and trusted partnerships, Versigent delivers versatile, intelligent solutions engineered to unlock greater capabilities for our customers. Powering one in six passenger vehicles in production today, Versigent&#8217;s high performance signal, power, and data distribution systems are trusted by industry leaders across automotive, commercial vehicles, agriculture and energy storage. With engineering and manufacturing centers on four continents and operations in more than 25 countries, Versigent&#8217;s 138,000 employees match global scale with regional responsiveness to deliver consistent quality and reliable performance connecting the world to faster, smarter and safer experiences. Visit </font><font style="color:#0057b7;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">www.versigent.com</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:112%">Use of Non&#8209;GAAP Financial Information</font></div><div style="height:42.75pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">2</font></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="min-height:42.75pt;width:100%"><div><font><br></font></div></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">This press release contains information about Versigent&#8217;s financial results which are not presented in accordance with GAAP. Specifically, Adjusted Revenue Growth, Adjusted EBITDA and Free Cash Flow are non-GAAP financial measures. Adjusted Revenue Growth represents the change in reported net sales relative to the comparable period, excluding the impact on net sales from currency exchange and commodity movements. Adjusted EBITDA represents net income (loss) before depreciation and amortization (including asset impairments), interest expense, income tax (expense) benefit, other income (expense), net, equity income (loss), net of tax, restructuring, separation costs related to the Spin-Off and other special items. Adjusted EBITDA margin represents Adjusted EBITDA as a percentage of net sales. Free Cash Flow represents cash provided by (used in) operating activities less capital expenditures.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">Management believes the non-GAAP financial measures used in this press release are useful to both management and investors in their analysis of the Company&#8217;s financial position, results of operations and liquidity. In particular, management believes Adjusted Revenue Growth,  Adjusted EBITDA and Free Cash Flow are useful measures in assessing the Company&#8217;s ongoing financial performance that, when reconciled to the corresponding GAAP measure, provide improved comparability between periods through the exclusion of certain items that management believes are not indicative of the Company&#8217;s core operating performance and that may obscure underlying business results and trends. Management also uses these non-GAAP financial measures for internal planning and forecasting purposes.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">Such non-GAAP financial measures are reconciled to the most directly comparable GAAP financial measures in the attached supplemental schedules at the end of this press release. Non-GAAP measures should not be considered in isolation or as a substitute for our reported results prepared in accordance with GAAP and, as calculated, may not be comparable to other similarly titled measures of other companies.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:112%">Forward&#8209;Looking Statements</font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">This press release contains forward-looking statements that reflect, when made, Versigent&#8217;s current views with respect to current events, business plans and financial performance. Such forward-looking statements are subject to many risks, uncertainties and factors relating to Versigent&#8217;s operations and business environment, which may cause the actual results of Versigent to be materially different from any future results. All statements that address future operating, financial or business performance or Versigent&#8217;s strategies or expectations are forward-looking statements. Factors that could cause actual results to differ materially from these forward-looking statements include, but are not limited to, the following&#58; disruptions in the supply of raw materials and other supplies integral to our products&#59; future significant public health crises and other global health crises and the measures taken in response thereto&#59; a prolonged recession and&#47;or a downturn in global automotive sales&#59; the volatile global economic environment and geopolitical conditions, including conditions affecting the credit market and global inflationary pressures&#59; our reliance on relationships with collaborative partners and other third parties for product development and such parties&#8217; failure to perform&#59; employee strikes and labor-related disruptions involving us or one or more of our customers affecting our operations&#59; fluctuations in interest rates and foreign currency exchange rates&#59; our failure to comply with the numerous laws and regulations to which we are subject&#59; adverse developments affecting one or more of our suppliers&#59; any adverse impact of legal proceedings and disputes in which we are involved&#59; challenges to our historical and future tax positions by taxing authorities&#59; an increase in our tax burden due to ongoing or future tax audits&#59; our failure to attract and retain key salaried employees and management personnel&#59; our failure to manage the transition to a standalone public company&#59; our failure to achieve some or all of the benefits expected from the Spin-Off and other risks related to the completion of the Spin-Off. Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">(Unaudited)</font></div><div style="text-align:center"><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">In this press release the Company has provided information regarding certain non-GAAP financial measures, including &#8220;Adjusted Revenue Growth&#8221;, &#8220;Adjusted EBITDA&#8221; and &#8220;Free Cash Flow&#8221;. Such non-GAAP financial measures are reconciled to their closest GAAP financial measure in the following schedules.</font></div><div style="text-indent:22.5pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="text-indent:22.5pt"><font><br></font></div><div id="i20b7ef60fdb94ad193806e0e6a4be19b_278"></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Adjusted Revenue Growth</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#58; Adjusted Revenue Growth is presented as a supplemental measure of the Company&#8217;s financial performance which management believes is useful to investors in assessing the Company&#8217;s ongoing financial performance that, when reconciled to the corresponding U.S. GAAP measure, provides improved comparability between periods through the exclusion of certain items that management believes are not indicative of the Company&#8217;s core operating performance and which may obscure underlying business results and trends. Our management utilizes Adjusted Revenue Growth in its financial decision making process, to evaluate performance of the Company and for internal reporting, planning and forecasting purposes. Adjusted Revenue Growth is defined as the change in reported net sales relative to the comparable period, excluding the impact on net sales from currency exchange and commodity movements. Not all companies use identical calculations of Adjusted Revenue Growth, therefore this presentation may not be comparable to other similarly titled measures of other companies.</font></div><div id="i20b7ef60fdb94ad193806e0e6a4be19b_240"></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="min-height:45pt;width:100%"><div><font><br></font></div></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Adjusted EBITDA</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#58; Adjusted EBITDA is presented as a supplemental measure of the Company&#8217;s financial performance which management believes is useful to investors in assessing the Company&#8217;s ongoing financial performance that, when reconciled to the corresponding U.S. GAAP measure, provides improved comparability between periods through the exclusion of certain items that management believes are not indicative of the Company&#8217;s core operating performance and which may obscure underlying business results and trends. Our management utilizes Adjusted EBITDA in its financial decision-making process, to evaluate performance of the Company and for internal reporting, planning and forecasting purposes. Adjusted EBITDA is defined as net income (loss) before depreciation and amortization (including asset impairments), interest expense, income tax (expense) benefit, other income (expense), net, equity income (loss), net of tax, restructuring, separation costs related to the Spin-Off and other special items. Not all companies use identical calculations of Adjusted EBITDA, therefore this presentation may not be comparable to other similarly titled measures of other companies. Adjusted EBITDA margin represents Adjusted EBITDA as a percentage of net sales.</font></div><div style="text-indent:22.5pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:center"><table Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:115%;text-decoration:underline">Free Cash Flow</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%">&#58; Free Cash Flow is presented as a supplemental measure of the Company&#8217;s liquidity, which is consistent with the basis and manner in which management presents financial information for the purpose of making internal operating decisions, evaluating its liquidity and determining appropriate capital allocation strategies. Management believes this measure is useful to investors to understand how the Company&#8217;s core operating activities generate and use cash. Free Cash Flow is defined as cash provided by (used in) operating activities less capital expenditures. Not all companies use identical calculations of Free Cash Flow, therefore this presentation may not be comparable to other similarly titled measures of other companies. The calculation of Free Cash Flow does not reflect cash used to service debt, pay dividends or repurchase shares and therefore, does not necessarily reflect funds available for investment or other discretionary uses.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><table style="border-collapse:collapse;display:inline-table;margin-bottom:5pt;vertical-align:text-bottom;width:98.245%"><tr><td
